layer: Fleet Revenue & Customer Account Intelligence v0.1
purpose: Convert verified order, delivery, POD, invoicing and profitability signals into explainable customer-account and fleet-revenue intelligence.
rules: only verified financial and operational signals may affect scored metrics
unverified or demo data cannot be presented as live revenue
safety or security events remain visible and cannot be hidden by commercial performance
conflicting verified commercial signals return REVIEW
account risk never automatically blocks a customer or driver
